card.name: Words like other or alternative before nouns
card.fires_on: Modifier words such as other, another, alternative or that that come right before a noun like drugs, opioid, treatment or patient in drug-label warnings. It also fires on 's after patient.

modes.label: Other/alternative modifier
modes.description: A word meaning other or alternative sits before a drug or treatment noun.
modes.example: reserve concomitant prescribing of these drugs for use in patients for whom<< alternative>> treatment options are inadequate.

modes.label: Patient reference
modes.description: The word patient or patient's appears where the text refers back to the same individual.
modes.example: Repeated evaluation of the patient<<'s>> condition is essential.

card.plain: It marks small words in label text that point to another drug, another treatment or the same patient, just before the noun comes.
